findings_WRITTEN_author_level: D1 (SEP decomposition): SEP <=> SEP-LEQ and SEP-R and SEP-L, where SEP-LEQ separates comparable e<f in one fibre E_c, SEP-R separates distinct R-related e,f in E_c (ef=f, fe=e), SEP-L dually. Proof: for e!=f in band E_c, either efe<e (separating efe from e separates e from f), or fef<f, or e D f in E_c and then e,ef,f give an R-pair or an L-pair whose separation separates e,f.

D2 (exact comparable criterion): for e<f in E_c, beta(e)!=beta(f) in B_q IFF (1,e) is NOT in Psi_f, the smallest subset of G x S containing (1,f) closed under composition (u,s),(u w(s,t),t) -> (u,st) and factorization (u,st) -> (u,s),(u w(s,t),t), with w(s,t)=g_s p_(lambda_s,i_t). Proof: Psi-sets are exactly complements of {0,1}-semilattice homomorphisms of the structure semilattice Y_q of B_q; [e@1]<=[f@1] in Y_q always; e@1<=f@1 in B_q and D-classes of bands are antichains.

D3 (2x2 grid is never an obstruction): if x,x' in R_f with q(x)=q(x'), y,y' in L_f with xy=x'y'=f, then xy'=f. Proof: m=yx', m'=y'x are idempotents by purity, mm'=yx=:n, so n m' n=n and xy'=x(n m' n)y=f.

D4 (sufficient condition): define Psi0_f={(pi(a,s),s): a in R_f, as in R_f}, pi(a,s)=g_a p_(lambda_a,i_s). Psi0_f contains (1,f) and is factor-closed. If it is also composition-closed (property COMP), then SEP-LEQ holds: (1,e) in Psi0_f with e<=f forces ae=f for some a in R_f, hence e=f.
